1 Sundays and Supreme Court Holidays are shown in red.

2 Holi,  Good  Friday,  Dussehra  and  Diwali  actually  fall  on
Tuesday, the 23<sup>rd</sup> March, 2027, Friday, the 26<sup>th</sup> March, 2027,
Saturday, the 9<sup>th</sup> October, 2027 and Friday, the 29<sup>th</sup> October,
2027 respectively.

3 The partial Court working days will commence on Monday, the
31<sup>st</sup> May, 2027 and the Full Court working days will resume
from Monday, the 12<sup>th</sup> July, 2027. The Registry of the Court will
be functioning throughout the partial Court working days except
on Saturdays, Sundays and Holidays. However, the Registry of
the Court will remain open on last Saturday of the partial Court
working days i.e. 10<sup>th</sup> July, 2027.

4 Independence  Day,  Milad-un-Nabi or  Id-e-Milad  and Guru
Nanak’s Birthday which fall on Sunday, the 15<sup>th</sup> August, 2027
and Sunday, the 14<sup>th</sup> November, 2027 respectively have not been
shown separately as these fall during Sundays.

5 Id-ul-Fitr, Id-ul-Zuha (Bakrid), Muharram and Milad-un-Nabi or
Id-e-Milad which fall on Wednesday, the 10<sup>th</sup> March, 2027,
Monday, the 17<sup>th</sup> May, 2027, Wednesday, the 16<sup>th</sup> June, 2027 and
Sunday, the 15<sup>th</sup> August, 2027 respectively are subject to change
depending upon the visibility of the Moon.

6 During the Christmas/ New year Holidays, the Registry will
remain closed from Saturday,  the  25<sup>th</sup> December,  2027 to
Saturday, the 1<sup>st</sup> January, 2028 (both days inclusive).
